Warehouse Selectors pick orders for delivery to foodservice venues in the local community.</p><ul><li><p>Active, physical role that includes operating an electric pallet jack, and/or forklift</p></li><li><p>Organizing and palletizing product to build customer orders</p></li><li><p>Other duties as assigned.</p></li></ul><p></p><p>Safe working environment, working in areas with temperature and humidity variations based on local weather conditions and type of product being selected (i.e., non-refrigerated, refrigerated, and frozen.)</p><p></p><p><u><b>Minimum Requirements</b></u></p><ul><li><p>Must be at least 18 years of age.</p></li><li><p>0 – 1 Year relevant work experience.</p></li><li><p>Frequently lift product that weighs 10lb - 75lbs and up to 100lbs.</p></li><li><p>Frequently reach up to 72 inches.</p></li><li><p>Constantly bend and twist while operating an electric pallet jack or forklift, retrieving products from lower shelf areas.</p></li><li><p>Work in very extreme temperatures (cooler and/or freezer).</p></li><li><p>Work on your feet for 10 – 12 hours daily.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><u><b>Preferred Requirements</b></u></p><ul><li><p>1 year experience operating an electric pallet jack or forklift.</p></li><li><p>1 year of warehouse, military, or physically active job experience.</p></li><li><p>1 year Selection Experience.</p></li><li><p>2 years consistent work history preferred.</p></li></ul></div>","identifier":"R264570","title":"Warehouse Order Selector","url":"https://careers.sysco.com/en/job/kent/warehouse-order-selector/1105/99722303904","directApply":"False","hiringOrganization":{"@type":"Organization","name":"US0055 Sysco Seattle, Inc.","logo":"https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/1105/cms/content/logos/Schema.jpg"},"jobLocation":[{"@type":"Place","address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","addressLocality":"Kent","addressRegion":"WA","addressCountry":"United States","streetAddress":"","postalCode":""}}]}</script>

        <h2 class="ajd_section__heading ajd_overview__heading">Overview</h2>
    
        <div class="max-width-wrapper">
            <p class="ajd_overview__about-job">Sysco is the global leader in foodservice distribution. With over 71,000 colleagues and a fleet of over 13,000 vehicles, Sysco operates approximately 333 distribution facilities worldwide and serves more than 700,000 customer locations. We offer our colleagues the opportunity to grow personally and professionally, to contribute to the success of a dynamic organization and to serve others in a manner that exceeds their expectations. We’re looking for talented, hard-working individuals to join our team. Come grow with us and let us show you why Sysco is at the heart of food and service.</p>

<section  id ="anchor-job-description" class="job-details-wrapper " data-section-id="148436" data-layout-item-id="52867">
    <div class="job-details-container">
        <div class="job-details-container__jd-details">
            
           

    <section class="job-description" data-selector-name="jobdetails" data-org-id="1105" data-job-id="99722303904" data-save-jobs="true">
        
        
		<div class="flex-jd">
		    
		    <div class="job-fecets">
		        <h2 class="job-headingh2">Warehouse Order Selector</h2> 
		        
		            <p class="job-location">Sysco Seattle - Kent</p>
				
                       
                <div class="facet-left">
 <span class="job-id job-info"><b>Job ID</b> R264570</span>  <span class="job-date job-info"><b>Date posted</b> 08/25/2026</span>                 </div>
           
		    
    		
            </div>
            
            <div class="ats-description">
		    
    		   <p class="job-info"><b>Employment Type</b> Full time</p>
    		
                 <span class="job-info"><b>Company name</b> US0055 Sysco Seattle, Inc.</span>
                
    		        <p class="job-info"><b>Compensation</b> 31.53-35.47</p>
    		
    		        <p class="job-info"><b>Compensation Range </b> The compensation range provided is in compliance with state specific laws.  Factors that may be used to determine your actual rate of pay include your specific skills, years of experience and other factors.</p>
    		
    		
    		
    		        <p class="job-info"><b>Job Profile Summary</b> Responsible for the storage and movement of materials and finished goods including: &#x2022; Shipping and receiving. &#x2022; Warehousing. &#x2022; Order filling, picking, and packing. &#x2022; Inventory control and records management &#x2022; Dispatch. &#x2022; Developing transport schedules, methods, and routes.&#xA;&#x2022; Analyzing and projecting transportation costs. &#x2022; Coordinating customs clearances and permits. &#x2022; Maintaining, loading, packing, and driving vehicles. &#x2022; Evaluating, selecting, and managing ongoing relationships with external transport providers (e.g., fuel suppliers, trucking/shipping companies, etc.). &#x2022; Acquiring and managing fleet vehicles. Other duties as assigned</p>
            
                <p class="job-info"><b>Description</b> <div><p><u><b>JOB SUMMARY</b></u><br />Work in a Sysco warehouse and be a critical member of the foodservice supply chain. Warehouse Selectors pick orders for delivery to foodservice venues in the local community.</p><ul><li><p>Active, physical role that includes operating an electric pallet jack, and/or forklift</p></li><li><p>Organizing and palletizing product to build customer orders</p></li><li><p>Other duties as assigned.</p></li></ul><p></p><p>Safe working environment, working in areas with temperature and humidity variations based on local weather conditions and type of product being selected (i.e., non-refrigerated, refrigerated, and frozen.)</p><p></p><p><u><b>Minimum Requirements</b></u></p><ul><li><p>Must be at least 18 years of age.</p></li><li><p>0 – 1 Year relevant work experience.</p></li><li><p>Frequently lift product that weighs 10lb - 75lbs and up to 100lbs.</p></li><li><p>Frequently reach up to 72 inches.</p></li><li><p>Constantly bend and twist while operating an electric pallet jack or forklift, retrieving products from lower shelf areas.</p></li><li><p>Work in very extreme temperatures (cooler and/or freezer).</p></li><li><p>Work on your feet for 10 – 12 hours daily.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><u><b>Preferred Requirements</b></u></p><ul><li><p>1 year experience operating an electric pallet jack or forklift.</p></li><li><p>1 year of warehouse, military, or physically active job experience.</p></li><li><p>1 year Selection Experience.</p></li><li><p>2 years consistent work history preferred.</p></li></ul></div></p>
                
    		   <p class="job-info"><b>Overview</b> Sysco is the global leader in foodservice distribution. With over 71,000 colleagues and a fleet of over 13,000 vehicles, Sysco operates approximately 333 distribution facilities worldwide and serves more than 700,000 customer locations.&#xA;&#xA;We offer our colleagues the opportunity to grow personally and professionally, to contribute to the success of a dynamic organization, and to serve others in a manner that exceeds their expectations. We&#x2019;re looking for talented, hard-working individuals to join our team. Come grow with us and let us show you why Sysco is at the heart of food and service.</p>
    		   <p class="job-info"><b>AFFIRMATIVE ACTION STATEMENT</b> Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States.&#xA;&#xA;We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected factor under federal, state or local law.&#xA;&#xA;This opportunity is available through Sysco Corporation, its subsidiaries and affiliates.</p>

        <section id="anchor-trending" class="ajd_section ajd_trending ajd-warehouse">
            <div class="text-wrapper">
                <h2 class="ajd_section__heading ajd_trending__heading">Hear From Our People</h2>
                <p>Our people are the fuel that powers Sysco. Explore colleague stories of growth and development with the company and in their own lives.</p>
            </div>
        <ul class="ajd_trending__ul">
            <li class="ajd_trending__li ajd_trending__li--one-col">

                <span class="ajd_trending__a"> <!-- <a> -->
                    <img class="ajd_trending__img" src="https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/1105/gst_v1_0/img/content/robertcollins3x.png" alt="Ricardo Broadway" />
